title: Database Administration
text:
## Database Administration
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000000583
The MySQL Database Manager allows direct access to the website database for querying, updating, and deleting records.
Important
Changes made directly to the database are permanent in most cases. Before executing any SQL statement, create a complete database backup and verify that the query targets the intended records.

## Access the Database Manager
Navigate to Developer Hub .
Select MySQL Database .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181046489/original/qBTpryn029mpwwYvjnK7FBmmi-n7ITy-nQ.png?1782417030 | alt: ]
Select the desired database from the left navigation panel.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181046578/original/H6aIm-_abIKW7Qd7-bkVr0TefGlDEd4EPA.png?1782417140 | alt: ]
Select the table to query.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181046645/original/OBd0ngQj-FV-BU6c0zusrGOArsIc6hfWHA.png?1782417213 | alt: ]
Select the SQL tab.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181046698/original/ZIkV1kuN18Jd7cUEspg4uLyPIwez9LPKUw.png?1782417281 | alt: ]
The SQL editor is now ready to execute queries.

## Retrieve Data
The SELECT statement retrieves information without modifying the database.

## Retrieve all members
The asterisk ( * ) returns every column in the selected table.

## Retrieve specific columns
Only the selected columns are returned.

## Summary
The SQL statements most commonly used for database administration are:
Statement Purpose SELECT Retrieve data UPDATE Modify existing records DELETE Permanently remove records
Always verify the affected records with a SELECT query before executing an UPDATE or DELETE statement.
